classification.difficultyReason: Select the appropriate nested triangle, find an intermediate side, interpret equal-length marks to assemble or halve a base, then apply Pythagoras again.

content.prompt: Find the value of $x$ in each question to 2 d.p.

spec.description: Upper-left apex, vertical left side, horizontal base, and an internal segment to the base. The two base segments have matching single ticks. No explicit right-angle marker is printed.
spec.mathematics: The internal hypotenuse is 29 cm and the left base segment is 21 cm. Equal base segments give a total base of 42 cm. The outer hypotenuse is x.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x are visible; calculated lengths and supplied answer are excluded.

answer.worked:
Let $h$ be the vertical height and $B$ the whole base, in centimetres. The marked base segments are equal.
$$\begin{align*}h&=\sqrt{29^2-21^2}\\h&=20\\B&=21+21=42\\x&=\sqrt{20^2+42^2}\\x&\approx46.52\ \text{cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upper-left apex, vertical left side labelled 21 cm, horizontal base, and an internal segment labelled 29 cm. Both base segments have matching single ticks. No explicit right-angle marker is printed.
spec.mathematics: The left base segment is sqrt(29²−21²)=20 cm. The whole base is twice that length. The outer hypotenuse is x.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x are visible; calculated lengths and supplied answer are excluded.

answer.worked:
Let $b$ be one marked base segment and $B$ the whole base, in centimetres.
$$\begin{align*}b&=\sqrt{29^2-21^2}\\b&=20\\B&=2\times20=40\\x&=\sqrt{21^2+40^2}\\x&\approx45.18\ \text{cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: A broad triangle with upper-left apex, vertical left side and horizontal base. The internal segment is labelled 29 cm and the left base segment 21 cm. Matching ticks occur on the vertical side and the right base segment. No explicit right-angle marker is printed.
spec.mathematics: The vertical height is sqrt(29²−21²)=20 cm. The right base segment equals the height, so the whole base is 41 cm. The outer hypotenuse is x.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x are visible; calculated lengths and supplied answer are excluded.

answer.worked:
Let $h$ be the vertical height and $B$ the whole base, in centimetres. The right base segment equals $h$.
$$\begin{align*}h&=\sqrt{29^2-21^2}\\h&=20\\B&=21+20=41\\x&=\sqrt{20^2+41^2}\\x&\approx46.62\ \text{cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upper-left apex, vertical side labelled 21 cm and horizontal base. The internal segment is labelled 29 cm. Matching ticks occur on the internal segment and the right base segment. No explicit right-angle marker is printed.
spec.mathematics: The left base segment is sqrt(29²−21²)=20 cm. The right base segment equals the 29 cm internal segment. The whole base is 49 cm and x=sqrt(21²+49²).
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x are visible; calculated lengths and the erroneous supplied answer are excluded.

answer.worked:
Let $b$ be the left base segment and $B$ the whole base, in centimetres. The right base segment equals the marked $29$ cm segment.
$$\begin{align*}b&=\sqrt{29^2-21^2}\\b&=20\\B&=20+29=49\\x&=\sqrt{21^2+49^2}\\x&\approx53.31\ \text{cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upper-left apex, vertical side labelled 21 cm, horizontal base, outer hypotenuse labelled 29 cm and internal segment labelled x. Matching single ticks occur on both base segments. No explicit right-angle marker is printed.
spec.mathematics: The whole base is sqrt(29²−21²)=20 cm. Equal base segments each measure 10 cm. The internal hypotenuse is x=sqrt(21²+10²).
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x are visible; calculated lengths and supplied answer are excluded.

answer.worked:
Let $B$ be the whole base and $b$ one marked base segment, in centimetres.
$$\begin{align*}B&=\sqrt{29^2-21^2}\\B&=20\\b&=20\div2=10\\x&=\sqrt{21^2+10^2}\\x&\approx23.26\ \text{cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upper-left apex, vertical left side and horizontal base. The outer hypotenuse is labelled 29 cm and the internal segment x. Matching ticks occur on the vertical side and the left base segment. A double-ended dimension arrow measures the entire base as 21 cm. No explicit right-angle marker is printed.
spec.mathematics: The height is sqrt(29²−21²)=20 cm. The left base segment equals the height. The internal hypotenuse is x=sqrt(20²+20²)=20sqrt(2) cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x are visible; calculated lengths and the erroneous supplied answer are excluded.

answer.worked:
Let $h$ be the vertical height and $b$ the left base segment, in centimetres. The dimension arrow gives the whole base as $21$ cm, and the marked lengths satisfy $b=h$.
$$\begin{align*}h&=\sqrt{29^2-21^2}\\h&=20\\b&=20\\x&=\sqrt{20^2+20^2}\\x&\approx28.28\ \text{cm}\end{align*}$$
